description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for Git stash functionality, particularly testing the interactive patch option `-p`. It includes setup commands, execution of `git stash save -p`, and verification of repository state before and after commands.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Sets and saves the state of the working directory, index, and HEAD for testing.

methods.name: save_head
methods.description: Saves the current HEAD state for verification.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the state of a specific file or the repository to specified conditions.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Simulates user input for testing interactive prompts.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail, used for negative test cases.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies the current state of the working directory, index, and HEAD.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Verifies that the current state matches the saved state.

methods.name: verify_saved_head
methods.description: Verifies that the HEAD state has not changed after operations.
